title: Blue Lace Blouse & Honey Waves
prompt: An original young woman with long, honey-blonde hair falling over one shoulder sits against a deep blue backdrop. She wears a sheer blue blouse with lace-trimmed cuffs and a ruffled placket, and a single silver drop earring. Her expression is calm and direct, with light freckles. Even studio light, a palette of cornflower blue, honey gold, and soft peach skin. Soft and retro, in the style of a late-1990s editorial portrait.
workingNotes:
- The sheer lace blouse and honey hair are the key textures.
- Add 'film grain' to match the vintage print look.
